 Order

Heard Shri A.K. Azad, learned counsel for the petitioner, namely, Shri Bikash Rajbongshi, who has filed this anticipatory bail application under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C. praying for pre-arrest bail in connection with Kamalpur P.S. Case No. 165/2023 registered under Sections 376/420 of the IPC.
Page No.# 2/2 Call for the Case Diary, fixing 15.11.2023.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Shri K. Baishya, learned Addl. Public Prosecutor, Assam shall do the needful.
Heard the learned counsel on the interim prayer.
It is submitted that a mere reading of the F.I.R. would reveal that the ingredients of the Sections mentioned would not be applicable.

After consideration of the same and the facts and circumstances narrated in the F.I.R., it is provided in the interim that in the event of arrest of the above named petitioner in connection with the aforementioned police station case, he shall be released on bail on furnishing a bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Authority.
The petitioner is directed to appear before the IO of the case on or before 31.10.2023 for recording his statement.
The petitioner is further directed to render full cooperation with the investigation of the case and not to indulge in any activities detrimental to the same.
